assumptions: A 'garment reused' is a project you marked as completed on the dashboard. Analyses and saved ideas are intentions, not outcomes, so they are never counted as reuse.
Each completed project is assumed to use exactly one garment.
Fabric diverted is the weight of that garment, as an upper bound: it assumes the whole garment is used and ignores offcuts that may still be discarded.

If you enter the garment's weight yourself, that figure is used. Otherwise a typical weight for the predicted garment category is assumed (see the catalog). Typical weights are rough author estimates, not measurements.
The weight of a garment kept out of the bin is not the same as an environmental saving. Reusing a garment avoids waste only to the extent it delays disposal.

environmental_factors.explanation: No verified per-kilogram carbon or water factor for upcycling is configured, so RE-THREAD does not report carbon or water savings. To add one, set 'enabled' to true and provide 'co2e_kg_per_kg', 'water_litres_per_kg', and a 'source' citation that you have checked. Until then the impact page shows only counts and fabric weights.
